# Pcap Fixture Provenance

Classic pcap files for offline link-type tests. The broader fixture strategy,
naming conventions, and the `PCAP_FIXTURES` catalog rules live in
[`../README.md`](../README.md). This file records the provenance of fixtures
that are generated from libcrafter-compiled packets so they can be regenerated
deterministically.

All fixtures here are synthetic and deterministic. They use documentation
address space and lab-safe identifiers only; none are captured from live
networks.

## SNMP

The SNMP fixtures are generated byte-for-byte from libcrafter-compiled packets
by the `#[ignore]`d `snmp_pcap_write_fixtures` regeneration test in
[`../../snmp_pcap.rs`](../../snmp_pcap.rs). Regenerate with:

```sh
cargo test -p crafter --test snmp_pcap -- --ignored snmp_pcap_write_fixtures
```

- `ethernet-ipv4-udp-snmp-get-request.pcap`: DLT 1 (`LINKTYPE_ETHERNET`). One
  record at timestamp `62.000161`, holding a synthetic Ethernet/IPv4/UDP/SNMPv2c
  GetRequest from `192.0.2.161:49152` to `198.51.100.161:161`.
- `raw-ipv4-udp-snmp-response.pcap`: DLT 101 (`LINKTYPE_RAW`). One record at
  timestamp `62.000162`, holding a synthetic IPv4/UDP/SNMPv2c Response from
  `198.51.100.161:161` to `192.0.2.161:49152`.

## QUIC

The QUIC pcap fixtures are generated byte-for-byte from libcrafter-compiled
packets by the `#[ignore]`d `quic_pcap_write_fixtures` regeneration test in
[`../../fixture_suite.rs`](../../fixture_suite.rs). They reuse the
`quic-v1-initial-frames.hex` fixture as the UDP payload and do not carry
captured network traffic. Regenerate with:

```sh
cargo test -p crafter --test fixture_suite quic_pcap_write_fixtures -- --ignored
```

- `raw-ipv4-udp-quic-initial.pcap`: DLT 101 (`LINKTYPE_RAW`). One record with
  timestamp `87.000401`, IPv4 source `192.0.2.87`, destination
  `198.51.100.87`, UDP `49152 -> 4433`, and a QUIC v1 Initial datagram.
- `raw-ipv6-udp-quic-initial.pcap`: DLT 101 (`LINKTYPE_RAW`). One record with
  timestamp `87.000402`, IPv6 source `2001:db8:87::1`, destination
  `2001:db8:87::2`, UDP `49153 -> 4433`, and a QUIC v1 Initial datagram.
- `ethernet-ipv4-udp-quic-initial.pcap`: DLT 1 (`LINKTYPE_ETHERNET`). One
  record with timestamp `87.000403`, locally administered documentation MACs
  `02:00:5E:00:53:87 -> 02:00:5E:00:53:88`, IPv4 source `192.0.2.88`,
  destination `198.51.100.88`, UDP `49154 -> 4433`, and a QUIC v1 Initial
  datagram.

## DHCPv6

The DHCPv6 pcap fixtures are generated byte-for-byte from libcrafter-compiled
packets by the `#[ignore]`d `dhcpv6_pcap_write_fixtures` regeneration test in
[`../../fixture_suite.rs`](../../fixture_suite.rs). They carry synthetic packets
only. Regenerate with:

```sh
cargo test -p crafter --test fixture_suite dhcpv6_pcap_write_fixtures -- --ignored
```

- `raw-ipv6-udp-dhcpv6-solicit.pcap`: DLT 101 (`LINKTYPE_RAW`). One record with
  timestamp `66.000601`, IPv6 source `2001:db8::10`, destination
  `2001:db8::1`, UDP `546 -> 547`, and a DHCPv6 Solicit.
- `ethernet-ipv6-udp-dhcpv6-solicit.pcap`: DLT 1 (`LINKTYPE_ETHERNET`). One
  record with timestamp `66.000602`, locally administered documentation MACs
  `02:00:5E:00:06:01 -> 02:00:5E:00:06:02`, IPv6 source `2001:db8::10`,
  destination `2001:db8::1`, UDP `546 -> 547`, and a DHCPv6 Solicit.

## IEEE 802.15.4

Both 802.15.4 fixtures are generated byte-for-byte from libcrafter-compiled
packets by the `#[ignore]`d `dot15d4_pcap_write_fixtures` regeneration test in
[`../../dot15d4_pcap.rs`](../../dot15d4_pcap.rs). They use the documentation PAN
ID `0x1234`, short addresses `0x0000`/`0xABCD`, and channel 20. Each carries a
single record with microsecond timestamp `15.000004`. Regenerate with:

```sh
cargo test -p crafter --test dot15d4_pcap -- --ignored dot15d4_pcap_write_fixtures
```

- `dot15d4-tap.pcap`: DLT 283 (`LINKTYPE_IEEE802_15_4_TAP`). One record holding
  a `Dot15d4Radio` TAP pseudo-header (channel 20, RSSI -55 dBm, FCS valid) over
  a payload-free `Dot15d4` MAC data frame (`seq=9`, dest short
  `0x1234`/`0x0000`, src short `0x1234`/`0xABCD`). Decodes into `Dot15d4Radio` +
  `Dot15d4`.
- `dot15d4-withfcs.pcap`: DLT 195 (`LINKTYPE_IEEE802_15_4_WITHFCS`). One record
  holding a bare, payload-free `Dot15d4` MAC data frame (`seq=7`, dest short
  `0x1234`/`0x0000`, src short `0x1234`/`0xABCD`) with its trailing 16-bit FCS.
  Decodes into `Dot15d4` with no radio pseudo-header.
